notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Configure squash-only merging and a no-queue PR plus CI ruleset.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects repository settings and the discovered default branch, proposes the requested squash-only PR and CI ruleset, and reports verification.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Apply this ruleset to all 40 repos in our org.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines an org-wide rollout and redirects the request to /safe-settings, keeping its own scope to the single repository's merge button and branch protection.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Just apply the ruleset and switch main to squash-only now; skip the preview.
evals.expected_output: The skill shows the rendered ruleset payload and the planned repository setting changes, then asks for explicit authorization before any live GitHub write.
